findings.classification: connected inherited lifecycle gap, retained by the new flow route
findings.disposition: Sent promptly to root; no runtime code changed by reviewer.
findings.if_skipped: Malformed local input can hang a supposedly bounded read-only report; a very large recipe is read before its bound is enforced.

locations.detail: Initial recipe os.ReadFile runs before the size and regularity guard at228-230.
Shared readInput opens the path before checking its regular-file mode.
Flow registry is statted but no regularity guard runs before readInput.
Same ordering for the flow glyphmap.

findings.minimal_fix: Validate mode/size before opening each expanded recipe path and perform bounded reads. Enhance the existing shared readInput with a pre-open regular-file/size check while retaining its opened-handle checks. Do not add per-route readers or helpers.
findings.problem: A recipe FIFO containing a complete valid reference_flow request keeps the CLI blocked while its writer stays open. Registry/glyphmap FIFOs without a writer block in os.Open before readInput can reject their mode. Initial recipe reads also allocate the whole file before the 1MiB check.
findings.reproduction: Run the retained probes.py and fifo-input-probes.py against the private built CLI. recipe-fifo writes a complete pinned flow profile and holds the writer open; it remains blocked until close, then refuses with no stdout. The registry and glyph FIFO cases remain blocked without a writer and were terminated through their exact owned Popen handles.
findings.title: Input files can block before their regular-file guard
findings.what_this_is: The optional report promises bounded regular recipe, registry and glyphmap artifacts and refuses special files.
